thumb.alt: A Claude Code plugin that remembers decisions and checks the final answer

title: A Claude Code plugin that remembers decisions and checks the final answer
lead: Restores decisions and promises after context compaction, and has a second model act as a skeptic before the final report.
problem: After context compaction, a long Claude Code session loses the thread: it forgets the owner's decisions and what was promised. It needed a way to bring that context back and to double-check the final report.
built: A SessionStart hook (on compact and resume) puts a summary back into context: working windows, decisions waiting for the owner, the day's rules.
A Stop hook runs Claude Haiku as a skeptic on final answers. It looks for unverified claims and missed promises; a serious finding blocks the answer with a reason.
The Haiku call is isolated: no tools, a single turn, a timeout.
New rules from the owner's messages are never written automatically: the plugin only prompts the lead, and the decision stays with the owner. No trigger words are hard-coded.
Changes from the skeptic's own review are included.

steps: A SessionStart hook restores decisions and promises after compaction.
A Stop hook sends the final answer to a tool-free, single-turn Haiku skeptic with a timeout.
A serious finding blocks the answer and shows the reason.
Everything runs on Node.js with no external dependencies.
offer: A Claude Code plugin with the two hooks, set up for your workflow.
Tests for hook behaviour, safe failures and timeouts.
not_included: Support for other assistants; a promised quality gain in percent.
